- Fixed instance of flickering mesh due to overlap

notes.title: v1.04 Splatter Cats DLC, Weather Customisation and Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content: [p]- Splatter Cats DLC - Release and Integration of free Splatter Cats DLC which features an additional splattertastic death mode [/p][p]- Weather Customisation - Options which allow users to customise the weather as well as a mode "Changing Weather" which features automated changing weather throughout the level [/p][p]- Additional Death Music - There's now an additional option in the audio settings which allow players to change between the default death music and a varied selection which picks at random from an additional 12 death music variations as well as the original [/p][p]- Helpful Death Tips - There's now an additional option in the gameplay settings which allows players to turn on some helpful death tips when they die [/p][p]- Checkpoint Improvements - Checkpoints have now been made even clearer with a floating arrow which moves up and down and rotates above checkpoints to help make it clearer for players (when in kitty cat sense mode) [/p][p]- Kitty Cat Sense Change - Kitty cat sense mode colours have been changed to a light blue colour to further match the style/colour palette of the rest of the game [/p][p]- Chapter Changes - The game has now been split into 6 chapters as opposed to the 3 before  [/p][p]- Chapter Save Notification - When reaching a chapter now an additional message will appear to inform the player the progress has been saved to make it clear for players [/p][p]- Update to Tips - The tips now reference checkpoints directly to make it clear to players that there are checkpoints and where they are [/p][p]- Additional Tip - Added a final tip at the first major blue beams section to remind players of slo mo functionality and how it should be used as players often forget and get stuck at this part [/p][p]- Additional Shortcuts - Multiple new shortcuts added [/p][p]- Additional Cosmetics - Multiple new cosmetic items added [/p][p]- Added Clothing Locations - In the steam discussions i have added a post to show which clothing is located in which chapter https://steamcommunity.com/app/2804680/discussions/0/601907675997987207/  [/p][p]- Font Language Scaling Fixes - Fixed some issues with fonts for non english languages scaling incorrectly  [/p][p]- Bug Fixes and Mesh Placements - Fixed a few minor bugs and adjusted/added/removed some meshes for better gameplay and due to incorrect or unrealistic placement[/p]

notes.title: v1.031 Ragdoll Bug Fix
notes.content: - An update to try and fix a bug in unreal engine where some computers/cpus when ragdoll is activated will cause the physics asset to go crazy and fly off. I've never been able to replicate the issue myself to test but i've made a change which should hopefully fix the issue

notes.title: v1.03: Improved Accuracy, Responsiveness and More Routes and Clothing
notes.content:
- Added additional traces to each paw to make the two paw rule slightly more forgiving and more accurate; there used to be one trace per paw there is now 3 traces per paw. Previously the cat would lean forward to go off an edge more easily now the cat will lean forward to go off an edge only when the front 2 paws are completely off an edge. Also previously the cat would ragdoll when the two back paws were just over half way off an edge now both back paws have to be completely off an edge.

- Improved jump time, some people were often jumping too late causing their jump to be cancelled or not triggered; the jump delay was roughly 0.08 seconds now it's down to roughly 0.05 seconds, the trade off is a worse animation as the jump animation often won't have time to blend properly but there is now greater responsiveness which is more important for gameplay. [i]To clarify jumps will not work/be triggered if the front two paws are over an edge and the cat has begun to fall as a result. Additionally if a jump has already been triggered and the back two paws pass over an edge and the cat has not yet pushed off the ground then the jump will be cancelled[/i]

- Made changes for steam deck compatibilty: re-encoded videos to vp9 codec to work with steam deck and added ability to detect steam deck and set appropriate resolution

- Added additional routes

- Added more clothing options
 - 21 additional headgear
 - 7 additional masks/glasses
 - 8 additional accessories

- Fixed collision geometry for curved beam

- Improved translations

- Game now defaults to highest available resolution

- Added additional areas for acquiring clothing

- Changed "fast and fluffy", "paws of speed", "turbo tabby" and "purrfect dash" achievements to 10 minutes as 5 minutes is too short

notes.title: Only Way is Down v1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added in speedrun practice mode which is available if you complete the game on any difficulty. This allows you to manually set a restart point allowing you to practice a particular run or jump within a checkpoint without having to get back to that point everytime. Further Details in Discussion Thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2804680/discussions/0/601900862720287952/
[*] Added missing collectibles
[*] Moved some badly lined up elements
[*] Resized a few incorrectly sized things
[*] Fixed some incorrect UI navigation
[/list]

notes.title: Only Way is Down v1.01: Increased save points, Ingame Kitty Customisation
notes.content:
Only Way is Down v1.01:
- Increased save points in casual mode. There are now 6 total save points as opposed to 3 before (each chapter is now split into 2). If you pass any of the save points in any of the difficulties the save point will be available when selecting casual mode. Provided you have passed the first save point when selecting casual mode an additional menu will show up allowing you to select which save point you want to start at 
- Customise Kitty Ingame; You can now customise the kitty while playing, the option is now in the pause menu
- Few other minor fixes
